algorithm: Keep the complete original scanner loop and its closing-quote/control/escape checks. Only at the existing plain_ascii successful branch inspect the already scanned content range.
Select a possible fixed literal using exact content length and first UTF16 unit, then compare every content unit against that literal. Return its existing literal string only if all units are equal.
Use the shared empty literal only as a no-match sentinel, never as the decoded value of an unknown string. Every empty/unknown/prefix/lookalike string uses the original get_view.to_owned fallback.
Escaped and non-ASCII strings retain the existing official JSON scalar decoder/cache and decoded identity validation. No normalization,case folding,trimming or broad ASCII acceptance changes.
Input identifiers whose exact contents happen to match a token may share the identical immutable string value. This does not turn an identifier into a field or change any dispatch context.
testsPlanned: Repeated full-schema field/model/status/kind input compares complete History to the existing reference parser.
User keys and identifiers equal fixed token spellings retain their actual roles and version references.
Escaped spellings of a recognized field/value decode identically; escaped/unescaped duplicate fields retain reference rejection.
Same-first-unit/length near misses,unknown fields,prefix/suffix lookalikes and case variants do not bypass validation.
Empty ordinary strings, leading/trailing spaces, ASCII-control errors, supplementary Unicode and unpaired-surrogate errors retain reference behavior.
